history.rule: Prior proof IDs remain historical. Each R20261114OV.BUN.* is a distinct observation in the final run.

proof_scope_notes: All 170 named results come only from the final successful run, including any lines interleaved after the Omni marker.
All 163 previous path/name pairs occurred exactly once; seven new cases occurred exactly once.
HTMLRewriter parses the real returned contribution. It does not execute browser focus/keyboard interaction or the installed WP01 consumer.
Both failed full selections are retained separately. The exact snapshot retry passed but did not resolve the narrow 5000ms timing margin.
No SessionV2, skill/grant, GNATIVE, Omni or integrated acceptance is claimed.

failures: Overview opens each canonical total into the correct record, monthly measure and version
Overview drills into the separately selected official budget and only the requested months
Overview leaves an unselected official unavailable instead of reusing candidate records
Overview keeps known budget, missing outlook, numeric zero and structural additions or removals distinct
Overview distinguishes original EUR inputs from converted USD measures and missing conversion
Overview preserves opaque record identities and escapes HTML without cross-selecting records
Overview retains published totals but exposes incomplete or divergent detail composition
RED.failure_cause: Missing data-overview-metric disclosure controls on the previous renderer; fixture setup and the preceding canonical metric assertions completed.

omni.verdict: not applicable (focused: no declaring test ran)

limits: RED exits at each first failing assertion; later detail assertions are not claimed until GREEN.
HTMLRewriter parses the real contribution output; no installed browser interaction was performed.
No missing import, fixture initialization, timeout or infrastructure error caused these failures.

GREEN.request_validator: Canonical script/test-ci-request.ts validateRequest plus script/test-ci-location.ts locateTestPackage and actual module manifests; metadata validation only. All 31 paths verified in the final product tree.

omni.verdict: not applicable (focused: no declaring test ran)

observed_limits.observation: HTMLRewriter inspects the actual rendered contribution and real Planner/SQLite fixtures. It does not run browser interaction, keyboard focus, screen-reader behavior, the WP01 mounted consumer, or a native resident session.

observed_limits.test: real WP11 rules bind a comparison, survive reopen and refuse a second binding or a stale rule
observed_limits.static_analysis: This test has no Overview import or call. It combines durable rule registration, comparison, save, idempotent retry, reopen, conflicting binding and stale-rule rejection with repeated replay/validation in one timeout window.
observed_limits.claim_limit: An exact retry passed; this does not prove the timing risk resolved.
